lambda_source: file: K-Alpha doublet weighted by ratioKAlpha2KAlpha1 0.5

background.rule: median of the last points of the curve, as the fit report takes it

counting.why: the detector saw at most 6.108E006 counts/s; no detector_max_cps given to judge it against

plateau_vs_first_order.why: measured ratio 0.250; no design to say what the first order should be against the plateau
plateau_vs_first_order.first_order_found_by: highest maximum after the plateau's first minimum (no design given: on a single film or a bare substrate this is a Kiessig fringe or noise, not a Bragg order)

total_reflection.why: the scan starts at 0.0477 deg theta and reaches its maximum at 0.2007 deg; no design to place the critical angle

orders_visible.why: 204 maxima stand more than 3 times above the background; without a design nothing says how many orders they are or how many there should be (on a single film or a bare substrate they are fringes or noise)

range_below_background.why: 2818 of 4635 points (60.8 %) sit at or below the background; no threshold says how much of a scan may be spent there

sampling.why: the grid step is 0.00150 deg theta; no design gives the total thickness the fringe spacing follows from

footprint.why: sample_length_mm and beam_width_mm are both needed for the footprint knee

zeros.why: 2085 of 4635 points (45.0 %) have a non-positive count, the first at 2.0322 deg theta (4.0645 deg 2theta); they were replaced by the smallest positive count before them and any background taken there is a floor, not a measurement
